title: Core internal moves, part 1: decision, catalog, change and panel zones
summary: Mechanical relocation of the core internal types of Attributes, Authorization, Catalog, Changes, Concerns, Configuration, Events, Kernel, Panels, Policies and Schema into `<Zone>\Internal\` exactly as the oracle rows say (≈49 rows, e.g. `Authorization\Authorizer` → `Authorization\Internal\Authorizer`, `Panels\PanelRegistry` → `Panels\Internal\PanelRegistry`, `Kernel\Grammar\PatternMatcher` → `Kernel\Internal\PatternMatcher`); references, docblocks, string FQCNs, `__DIR__` paths, allowlist paths and pinned snapshots follow. No behavior change.
why: D13: implementation lives under `<Zone>\Internal\` so boundaries are visible in the namespace and the I2–I4 scans stay mechanical; P3 moves each internal type once. Hard risk: a missed string FQCN (config, JSON fixture, phpstan ignore, stub, docs) or a stale `__DIR__` path breaks only at runtime — the sweep in #moves and the full suite catch it.

include: Rows with action `move` or `close+move` and phase `P3` whose current FQCN is in Attributes, Authorization, Catalog, Changes, Concerns, Configuration, Events, Kernel, Panels, Policies and Schema (knowledge/type-map #zone-attributes, #zone-authorization, #zone-catalog, #zone-changes, #zone-concerns, #zone-configuration, #zone-events, #zone-kernel, #zone-panels, #zone-policies, #zone-schema)

`AzGuardServiceProvider`, Filament and module files follow the renamed internals (Filament and modules must still use only attributed symbols: an internal referenced from them is an I4 defect to report, not to allowlist)
Pinned snapshots that name moved classes regenerated in writer mode (list them in the result)
Migration line for `Kernel\Grammar\PatternMatcher` (published at 0.7, now internal): no replacement; use `PermissionPattern`

reads.why: Rules every P3 item follows (reference + amendments win, no shims, placement, oracle, allowlists, snapshots, migration lines, tests)
Exact validation commands, PHP 8.4, driver ports, composer update rule
Exact move procedure: oracle-driven Rector map, git mv, string sweep, __DIR__ depth, snapshot regeneration
Supported-symbol changes of this area to write as migration lines

rules: After the item, for every moved row `git grep -nF '<old FQCN>' -- packages tests bench bin phpstan.neon` is empty (docs/upgrade.md excepted).
Each moved file declares exactly its oracle target FQCN at its oracle target_path.

validation.cmd: php -d memory_limit=1G vendor/bin/pest tests/Unit tests/Feature/Authorization tests/Feature/Catalog tests/Feature/Changes tests/Feature/Panels tests/Feature/Policies tests/Feature/Schema tests/Contracts --fail-on-skipped
php -d memory_limit=1G vendor/bin/pest tests/Feature/Parity tests/Feature/InactiveCost tests/Regression --fail-on-skipped
composer analyse && composer lint:check && composer refactor:check && composer api:check

deliverables: Attributes, Authorization, Catalog, Changes, Concerns, Configuration, Events, Kernel, Panels, Policies and Schema internals under Internal namespaces
